thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed on streaming.gateway.prod — spike started ~1918203300. Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate/paged. Error breakdown: 502/504 and chunked encoding resets. Notified on-call: @alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): seeing it. clients reporting disconnects and partial streams. I can take initial triage. any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T10:45 UTC -> prod: service/runtime-gateway v3.14.1 (canary -> 5%)

ben (runtime): I rolled a tiny canary at 10:45 but traffic shaping should keep it isolated. I’ll pull logs from the gateway.

carla (sre): i'm seeing gateway 5xx rate jump at 10:48, correlates with burst of streaming requests with long-lived connections. Backend Nginx shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)`. attaching snippet:

```
2026-03-15T10:48:03Z nginx[info]: 502 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.8.2.45, server: , request: "POST /v1/chat/stream HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.9.0.12:5000/", host: "api.redwood.example"
2026-03-15T10:48:07Z kernel[warn]: tcp_abort: rst sent on closed socket
```

carla (sre): also see sporadic 499s (client closed) mixed in, but 502/504 volume is high.

alice (oncall): customer-impact check: Support reports 3 enterprise customers with streaming timeouts, perceived "incomplete responses". Not yet GDPR/hipaa affected. CS triage loop assigned to support-team.

support-team: confirmed — two customers in NA, one EU. Severity: degraded streaming UX, occasional total failures. They're throttling retries, but some customers use long open streams (LLM chat UIs).

ben (runtime): hypothesis: our gateway is sending chunked transfer responses but our runtime instances are hitting an internal backpressure bug that closes the upstream connection if KV cache miss + long decode loop occurs. When upstream closes mid-chunk, client sees truncated chunked encoding -> immediate disconnects.

dave (platform): can we fail open to non-chunked path or reduce streaming window? I can flip a config to force non-chunked (buffer-and-send) on the gateway for affected routes. That will increase memory but may blunt disconnects.

alice (oncall): proposed live mitigations (quick):
- increase gateway upstream timeout from 30s -> 90s for /v1/chat/stream (temporary)
- enable buffer-mode (disable chunked) on gateway for /v1/chat/stream and /v1/generate/paged
- roll traffic back off canary to 0% until runtime fix verified
- notify CS and keep customers updated with ETA

carla (sre): I'm +1 on buffer-mode. flipping timeout is low-risk. will coordinate with dave. ben, want to stop canary?

ben (runtime): stopping canary now. rolling back v3.14.1 -> stable v3.14.0. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-gateway --to-revision=3` (started)

deploy-bot: Rollback started for runtime-gateway; progress: pods terminating -> new pods with v3.14.0 reclaiming 0/3 -> 2/3

dave (platform): toggled gateway buffer-mode for `/v1/chat/stream` and `/v1/generate/paged` at 10:54 UTC. Also bumped upstream read timeout to 90s. Watch for memory pressure on edges.

carla (sre): after buffer-mode -> 10 minutes: 5xx rate dropped ~80%. Some residual 5xx are internal 500s from runtime due to the bug; but major gateway 502/504s resolved.

alice (oncall): customer update: CS posted interim message: we are mitigating and expect partial recovery; recommending clients retry with exponential backoff.

ben (runtime): digging into runtime logs: reproduced condition locally where a long streaming decode + KV-cache miss triggers `write` failure when proto buffer flush hits closed socket. There's an unhandled exception path that closes connection instead of sending a final error chunk. Working on patch to send proper terminal error chunk and backpressure gracefully.

alice (oncall): ETA for runtime patch?

ben (runtime): patch branch opened, unit + integration tests running. if green, we can roll a hotfix to canary with traffic-stepped rollout in ~50 minutes.

incidents-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff scheduled at 11:30 UTC. Current primary: alice (oncall). Next oncall: dave (platform) will take over if not resolved before handoff.

alice (oncall): handoff plan: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then pass to dave with summary + links to logs/dashboards. Current mitigations in place: buffer-mode, upstream timeout bump, canary rollback. Impact: degraded streaming for 3 customers, overall 5xx spike resolved by 80%.

dave (platform): ack. prepping runbook entry: `streaming-gateway-buffer-fallback` and adding a monitoring alert to detect `chunked-termination` patterns.

carla (sre): postmortem note for later: investigate adding graceful terminal-chunk contract across runtime variants so clients always get a consistent terminal chunk or semantic error, preventing partial chunked truncation. Also consider autoscale buffer memory thresholds to avoid OOM.

support-team: customers opted for status updates every 30m. will escalate to account owners for the 3 affected customers. no legal/regulatory escalation yet.

ben (runtime): putting draft PR for the runtime fix: `fix/stream-terminal-chunk-handling`. I'll request expedited review. If approved we do canary to 1% -> 10% -> 50% with health checks for chunked disconnect metrics.

alice (oncall): everything noted. continuing watch. current status: mitigation active, error rates trending down, rolling mitigation tasks assigned. will update thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
